answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if its claims or actions fail a randomly audited task, and make bond size determine how much influence it earns. Audits should sample across tasks and identities, so splitting one operator into a spiral of accounts does not dilute the chance of detection; linked funding and repeated behavior can trigger deeper review. A willow-soft reputation alone is cheap to fake, but a prism of independent checks makes Sybils costly: the attacker must lock real capital per identity and risks losing it on each failure.
